hooks.command: sh -c 'for d in "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}" "$HOME/.codex"; do for f in "$d"/plugins/cache/*/ultragoal-codex/*/scripts/codex-goal-gate.sh "$d"/plugins/cache/*/*/ultragoal-codex/*/scripts/codex-goal-gate.sh; do [ -f "$f" ] && exec sh "$f"; done; done; if [ -f plugins/ultragoal-codex/scripts/codex-goal-gate.sh ]; then exec sh plugins/ultragoal-codex/scripts/codex-goal-gate.sh; fi; exit 0'

sh -c 'for f in "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"/scripts/codex-agent-bootstrap.sh "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"/plugins/cache/*/ultragoal-codex/*/scripts/codex-agent-bootstrap.sh "$HOME/.codex"/plugins/cache/*/ultragoal-codex/*/scripts/codex-agent-bootstrap.sh "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"/plugins/cache/*/*/ultragoal-codex/*/scripts/codex-agent-bootstrap.sh "$HOME/.codex"/plugins/cache/*/*/ultragoal-codex/*/scripts/codex-agent-bootstrap.sh plugins/ultragoal-codex/scripts/codex-agent-bootstrap.sh; do [ -f "$f" ] && exec sh "$f"; done; exit 0'

sh -c 'for d in "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}" "$HOME/.codex"; do for f in "$d"/plugins/cache/*/ultragoal-codex/*/scripts/codex-session-context.sh "$d"/plugins/cache/*/*/ultragoal-codex/*/scripts/codex-session-context.sh; do [ -f "$f" ] && exec sh "$f"; done; done; if [ -f plugins/ultragoal-codex/scripts/codex-session-context.sh ]; then exec sh plugins/ultragoal-codex/scripts/codex-session-context.sh; fi; exit 0'

sh -c 'for f in "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"/scripts/codex-executor-evidence-gate.sh "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"/plugins/cache/*/ultragoal-codex/*/scripts/codex-executor-evidence-gate.sh "$HOME/.codex"/plugins/cache/*/ultragoal-codex/*/scripts/codex-executor-evidence-gate.sh "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"/plugins/cache/*/*/ultragoal-codex/*/scripts/codex-executor-evidence-gate.sh "$HOME/.codex"/plugins/cache/*/*/ultragoal-codex/*/scripts/codex-executor-evidence-gate.sh plugins/ultragoal-codex/scripts/codex-executor-evidence-gate.sh; do [ -f "$f" ] && exec sh "$f"; done; exit 0'
